sourceAnimation.screenshotMatch: The screenshot's 1188 × 1188 media panel closely matches source GIF frame 3 after scale; the saved file is therefore a visual match to the displayed X-native GIF, not a byte-level extraction from X.

pixelPolicy: Every visible account identity, avatar, verification badge, source sentence, reply sentence, and native GIF/ALT pill is an exact crop of the retained screenshot. The reaction media uses the exact user-supplied GIF frames. No interface wording, identity, face, or reaction frame was regenerated.
motionPolicy: The output preserves all 41 source frames at 40 ms each. Pixels outside the 900 × 900 media rectangle remain identical across every decoded output frame. The fixed native GIF/ALT pills are composited after the moving panel.

watermarkPolicy.placement: Both marks sit outside the borrowed GIF panel and identify only the JeloCare editorial composition.
watermarkPolicy.ownershipBoundary: The watermark identifies JeloCare's edit; it is not a licence, ownership claim, or authority to reuse the Showmax/GIPHY media or the source account's identity and words.

imageGeneration.reason: Exact screenshot and GIF compositing preserves the live exchange and avoids fabricated account, face, or interface pixels.

publicationBoundary: The Zapshot poster and GIF remain ignored, local, private, and unpublished. Cross-platform publication requires compatible third-party rights and fresh action-time confirmation.
